ticker: New: ₹3,100 Paddy Price set for Kharif 2026 | PM-KISAN 18th Installment released | Fasal Bima claims portal now live | Odisha CM-KISAN benefits extended to landless farmers

schemes.benefit: Paddy procurement price raised to ₹3,100/quintal for Kharif 2026 season in Odisha.
₹2,030 Crore allocated for 51 lakh farming families. ₹4,000 per family annually.
Annual assistance increased to ₹9,000 per farmer family. 18th installment released July 2026.
₹400 Crore for Millet cultivation promotion in Odisha. Subsidies on millet seeds and equipment.
Crop insurance at just 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi. Claims portal now fully digital.
Collateral-free loans up to ₹1.6 lakh at 4% interest (with subvention). Dairy & fisheries now included.
eKYC and Aadhaar-bank linking correction window open till Sept 2026 for pending beneficiaries.
Free soil testing and nutrient recommendations. Over 23 Crore cards issued nationwide since 2015.
